blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these mean twice the sum of x and three? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all that mean “twice the sum of x and three”.

blocks.text: Two times the quantity x plus three. Add first, then double. Right.
Two x plus six is two times the quantity x plus three, with the two distributed. Right.
Two x plus three doubles only the x. Not a match.
x plus six does not double the x. Not a match.
Two plus the quantity x plus three adds two. Twice means multiply.
Two of them are right: two times the quantity x plus three, and two x plus six. The second is the first with the two distributed.
